blocks.text: The Mughal attack comes suddenly while the small Singh band is scattered across ordinary camp tasks such as sleeping, gathering fodder, and fetching fuel. Mughal troops ran in all four directions so that the assault would overwhelm the camp before it could properly form for battle.

The first shock is deadly because the Singhs are caught in a vulnerable condition. Even so, the page emphasizes how quickly disorder gives way to resolve once they understand that escape is impossible and martyrdom may be near.
The fight is recast as a test of steadfastness rather than numbers. The survivors stand where they are, while absent companions begin to hurry back toward the sound of gunfire.
